name: lantern-orange
description: Lantern Orange: illustrated slides, cut-away machines and buildings, close-up portrait scenes, annotated concept figures, title and break slides, seamless GIF/MP4 loops, and a small UI kit with code tokens, in the Orange colour theme (warm near-black ground, one tangerine light, grain, silhouette figures, glowing flow lines), in dark or light with seven type sets.
